summary: Iter74 verification (frontend-focused + backend regression). BUG1 (Cards Jugador<->Cuerpo Tecnico toggle clearing team) is NOT reproducible - team_id is preserved in both directions. FEATURE2 (Goleadores Team->Player cascade) works fully: player select disabled until team chosen, list filtered per team, player reset on team change, save persists team_id via PUT /api/matches/{id}/result, and legacy scorers stored with only player_id are correctly backfilled to show the right team. FEATURE3 (public /datos-estadisticas standings) now renders the 5 real teams for PRUEBA 2028 in both 'Premier Impares CAT: 2009' and 'Premier Pares CAT: 2018'. FEATURE4 (CMS Grupo dropdown from real fixtures) works: Torneo -> Categoria -> Grupo cascade populates 'Grupo H' from fixtures and PUT /api/home-settings persists. Backend pytest: 14/15 passed (only failure is a documented brute-force-lockout gap through the public ingress). One NEW frontend bug found: the public Goleadores table shows '-' instead of player names (field name mismatch).

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout (5 fails -> 429) works when hitting the app directly (localhost:8001) but is NOT enforced through the public ingress: 6 consecutive bad logins for the same email all returned 401. Cause: identifier = f'{request.client.host}:{email}' and behind the proxy client.host is not the real/stable client IP. Use X-Forwarded-For (first hop) or key the counter by email only.
No single-match GET endpoint exists (405 Method Not Allowed); clients must fetch the whole list. Not blocking, but worth adding for detail/verification flows.

group_name comparison is exact/case-sensitive (documented in tests): 'GRUPO H' returns [] while 'Grupo H' returns data. The CMS dropdown now prevents typos, but a case-insensitive match (or normalization on save) would make this robust.

ui_bugs.issue: Goleadores table renders '-' in the Jugador column for every scorer. GET /api/stats/top-scorers returns the field `name` (e.g. TEST_ARIAS) but the component reads `r.player_name`. Fix: use r.name (or r.player_name || r.name).

top-scorers is requested with only `category` and `limit` - tournament_id and group_name from the CMS config are NOT sent, so scorers of any tournament sharing the same category number will leak into the panel (standings correctly send tournament_id+group_name).

Event tab clicks issued while the hero image is still loading are lost (layout shifts after the home-settings fetch + image load, so the click lands on the old position). Reproduced twice with Playwright trusted clicks; works reliably once the page settles. Consider reserving hero height / min-h to avoid CLS.

Not a bug but a behavioural note: toggling Jugador -> Cuerpo Tecnico -> Jugador keeps team_id but clears player_id (by design, since the staff toggle sets player_id:''). The review request expected the player selection to also survive the round trip; confirm the intended UX.

issues: Before home-settings resolves, the categories area briefly shows 'Aun no hay categorias configuradas para este evento' which reads like an error state; a skeleton/loading state would be better.

action_items: Fix ScorersTable in /app/frontend/src/pages/DatosEstadisticas.jsx: use `r.name` (API field) instead of `r.player_name` - public Goleadores currently shows '-' for all players.
Send tournament_id (and group_name if used) to /api/stats/top-scorers from CategoryDataPanel so scorers are scoped to the configured tournament.
Harden login brute-force lockout: derive client IP from X-Forwarded-For or key attempts by email, since the current key never accumulates behind the ingress.
Optional: make /api/stats/standings group_name matching case-insensitive as a defence-in-depth against legacy CMS values.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminMatches.jsx is 1351 lines - CardsEditor/ScorersEditor/CardsReport/FilterAndExportBar should be split into separate files (>700 line guideline).
ScorersEditor and CardsEditor duplicate the same players-fetch effect and teamOptions construction; extract a shared hook (useMatchRoster) to keep team/player filtering logic in one place.

Console shows a React hydration warning from the dev instrumentation injecting <span> inside <option> in AdminMatches selects (x-dynamic wrappers). Harmless in preview but noisy - worth confirming it does not appear in a production build.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (4 verified features, 1 new display bug in public Goleadores)

rca_of_the_issue: FEATURE3 root cause was a case mismatch between the CMS-stored group_name ('GRUPO H'/'H') and the fixture's real group_name ('Grupo H'); GET /api/stats/standings does an exact string match, so it returned []. The data fix plus the new fixture-driven Grupo dropdown resolve it (verified: 'Grupo H' returns 5 rows, 'GRUPO H' still returns []). BUG1 could not be reproduced: updateCard() only patches target_kind (+clears the opposite target field) and never touches team_id, so the team select keeps its value; the staff dropdown is populated from teams[team_id].cuerpo_tecnico and correctly listed 'TEST_DT PEREZ (Director tecnico)'. NEW bug: public Goleadores shows '-' because ScorersTable reads r.player_name while /api/stats/top-scorers returns r.name.
